review_basis: inputs/path_glossary_bundle.json: concept contexts, blocked_future_concepts and required facts
scenario_asset_registry.json: scenario and referenced authored examples
tile_lessons/*.json: assembled lesson text and sampled interactions

coverage.text_review: Exhaustive across all four assembled lessons, including titles, prose, code walkthroughs, nested side-by-side content, media labels/summaries/bridges, recaps, up-next text and remediation text. Applied each step's concept-specific blocked list; recap concepts are already taught within the tile.
coverage.interaction_sampling_method: Stratified across all four tiles, covering both choice and classify interactions; reviewed complete sampled prompts, options/items, hints and feedback.

findings_summary: No reviewed content requires understanding a blocked future concept. Dataset-version text's mention of reproduction and the up-next references are passing mentions, not prerequisites. Container building, starting, inspecting, logging and runtime-secret handling in the package lesson are explicitly required by the current model_preprocessing_package glossary facts, not leakage from later service/deployment concepts. Protected comparison uses fixed deployment probabilities and operating requirements as supplied inputs taught by the current concept; it does not require understanding later deployment or release-gate mechanisms. Managed-training resource/time bounds and terminal-resource release are taught by the current bounded_managed_training facts, without requiring later workload-cost or cleanup concepts. No deterministic gates were rerun.
